stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Cate Redfern on 38 pts - minor premiership form, and unlike Fremantle they don't have to face Hawthorn

stories.title: Someone Call Security
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 3 & 15 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 3 big ones on holes 2, 7 & 17 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 122 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 8 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 14 & 15

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 14 & 15 - the field is on notice

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ from 14 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: The One-Point Purist
stories.detail: 8 1-pointers, zero wipes - a very niche skillset

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 8 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 9 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 9 & 10 - this is momentum

stories.title: The One-Point Buffet
stories.detail: 5 in a row on holes 10-14 - help yourself, there are plenty

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 8-11 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 10, wipe on hole 11 - the course corrects

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 10, 1-pointer on hole 11

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 9 & 10 - the course always takes its cut
